image_description: Two compact audio cassettes placed side-by-side on a white surface. The left cassette has a colorful abstract label with pink and orange gradients, while the right cassette features a 'K7' logo and text indicating '60 mins'. Both have transparent plastic casings revealing the internal spools and tape mechanism. A third partial cassette is visible on the far right edge.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text 'K7' and surrounding smaller text appears slightly warped and inconsistent in font weight, typical of AI-generated text rendering, though largely legible.
The text 'Compact Cassette' on the white oval sticker appears slightly soft and lacks the crisp edge definition expected from printed paper, blending slightly into the background.
The partial cassette on the extreme right edge shows distorted geometry; the internal spool window is irregularly shaped and the casing edge seems to melt into the background.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of object is indeed a compact audio cassette and not a similar rectangular object.
To rigorously evaluate the legibility and correctness of the text on the labels, which showed signs of gibberish.
To verify the structural integrity of the transparent plastic shells and ensure no fusion between internal spools and external casing.
To assess general sharpness, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle global artifacts missed by specific auditors.

focus_areas: Boundary separation between transparent casing and internal tape
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the right cassette. While 'K7' is visible, check if the surrounding smaller text is nonsensical. Also, verify if the transparency effects on the plastic casing are physically consistent with light refraction, or if they appear flat/painted on.
